plan.title: [framework-gap] xbrief:preflight hard-refuses active briefs after any comment on the origin issue (slice origin-content-compare)

narratives.Description: xbrief:preflight no longer refuses an active brief only because its origin issue's updated_at moved. On drift it compares what the brief holds from the authoritative origin (stored body, stored comment thread, or Spec-path source) with the live origin, refuses on a requirement change, and warns on other activity. This brief is the single slice origin-content-compare of #7007; its contract is the accepted lean 7087466393.
narratives.Overview:
- Authoritative origin and baseline. A Spec-path brief (one with a `readSpecPathSourceRecord` record) uses the record's issue, the parent for a slice. A body-route brief (one with an ingest `plan.narratives.Origin` and no Spec-path refused-body record) uses the issue named in that Origin; its body baseline is `plan.narratives.Overview`, or an empty body when ingest wrote no `Overview`. Any other brief has no baseline. `evaluateOriginFreshness` checks the authoritative origin's `updated_at` first; no drift means pass, as today.
- Body compare. On drift for a body-route brief, preflight compares `scan(<live body>).transformed_content` (the transform ingest used) with the body baseline, ignoring trailing whitespace. Different: refuse with the reason "origin body changed".
- Comment compare (body-route brief, whose stored thread was read from its authoritative issue). On drift, preflight reads the live thread with `fetchIssueComments`. A comment is unread when its id is not in `plan.metadata.issueCommentThread` or its `updated_at` is newer than the stored entry; a brief with no stored thread treats every comment newer than its stamp as unread. An unread comment refuses when it starts with the design-critique comment lead (`model:` then `role:`), when it is the comment `selectIngestCurrentShape` selects, or when it carries an `## Acceptance Criteria` list (`criteriaListUnits`) and its author is the issue author, or `hasWritePermission` says the author may write, or `hasWritePermission` cannot answer. The same three shape tests also run on each stored comment (its scanned body in `issueCommentThread`, author checked the same way): a stored comment that had a requirement shape refuses when the live thread no longer has its id or has it with a newer `updated_at`, whatever its live shape. Every other unread comment goes into one `WARN:` line with count, ids and URLs, never comment text, telling the agent to read them before implementing (#2143). A failed or incomplete thread read refuses.
- Spec-path compare. On drift for a Spec-path brief, preflight runs `fetchSpecPathLiveIdentities` on the recorded source and compares the digest with the brief's pin, as `verify:ac` does. Mismatch or unavailable: refuse. A body change on that issue is a `WARN:` line (the lean is the contract). Its thread is read with `fetchIssueComments` without the stored thread (which, for a slice, belongs to the child issue): an unread comment is one with `updated_at` newer than the brief stamp, judged by item 3's live shape tests; a requirement shape or unknown author permission refuses, other comments go into the `WARN:` line, and a failed read refuses. An edit or delete of the recorded lean or criteria record, or a later arc, is caught by the source resolver itself (harvest digest and completed-arc read), since that record, not the rest of the thread, is a Spec-path brief's contract.
- Warn-only cases. Every origin other than the authoritative one (including a slice's child issue) prints a `WARN:` line naming it and never refuses, including when its fetch fails. A closed authoritative origin prints a `WARN:` line; closure alone never refuses, and it never stops items 2-4 or a failed fetch of the authoritative origin from refusing. A brief with no baseline keeps today's timestamp refusal.
- Recovery text. The reject names its reason (body changed, requirement comment, Spec-path source changed, author permission unknown, no baseline, origin unavailable) and prints the block/unblock pair and the usage line with `formatFrameworkCommand` (`deft scope:block -- <path>`, `deft xbrief:preflight -- <path>`), keeps the #3857 pointer, and keeps "restore `gh` access" for the unavailable cases. The sync and refinement skills (pack source, regenerated) describe this rule instead of a refusal on any newer `updated_at`. CHANGELOG line.
- Tests: a plain comment, a label, a close and a same-content body edit pass with the WARN; a changed body, a Constraints-only body change, a changed body on a closed origin, an edited old comment that adds an Acceptance Criteria list, an Acceptance Criteria comment whose author permission read fails, an ingest-time Acceptance Criteria comment edited to plain text, the same comment deleted, a new design-critique record and a changed Spec-path lean refuse; an issue ingested with an empty body passes a plain comment and refuses a new body; a slice is checked against its parent issue, and a slice with a non-empty child thread, an unchanged parent lean and a plain parent comment or label passes with the WARN, while a newer Acceptance Criteria comment by a writer on the parent refuses; a referenced origin's drift or fetch failure warns; a failed thread read refuses; a brief with no baseline refuses on drift; the WARN never contains comment text; the printed recovery strings are exact, and the printed `deft` commands resolve through the CLI router.
- For a brief with a baseline (a body-route brief ingested from an issue, or a Spec-path brief with a source record), a comment with no requirement shape, a label, a close and a same-content body edit on the authoritative origin no longer make `xbrief:preflight` refuse; it passes with one `WARN:` line naming the new comments by id and URL, without their text.
- A changed body (also on a closed origin), a new or edited comment with a design-critique comment lead, a selected Current shape comment, or an Acceptance Criteria list whose author is the issue author, a writer, or of unknown permission, a comment that had one of those shapes at ingest and is now edited or deleted, and a changed Spec-path source still refuse.
- A Spec-path brief is compared through its recorded source issue and lean, the parent issue for a slice; its newer comments are judged by live shape, never against the child's stored thread, so harmless parent activity on a slice with a child thread passes.
- A referenced origin other than the authoritative one only warns, including on a fetch failure; a failed or incomplete thread read of the authoritative origin refuses; a brief with no baseline keeps today's timestamp refusal.
- The reject names its reason and prints `deft scope:block -- <path>`, `deft scope:unblock -- <path>` and `deft xbrief:preflight -- <path>`, which resolve through the CLI router.
- The sync and refinement skills describe the new rule, with a CHANGELOG line.
narratives.Constraint:
- Treating an equal acceptance-pin digest as proof that the origin is unchanged (comment 7087292767, finding 1).
- Comparing a Spec-path brief through its local Overview or the first reference (comment 7087292767, finding 2).
- Passing on an unreadable comment thread (comment 7087292767, finding 3).
- A new refusal for a closed origin, or a closure that exempts a changed body or requirement comment (comment 7087292767, finding 4; comment 7087355920, finding 1).
- Reading a failed permission lookup as "not a writer" (comment 7087355920, finding 2).
- Judging a comment only by its live shape, so an edited-away or deleted requirement comment escapes (comment 7087404461, finding 1).
- Comparing a slice's parent thread with the child issue's stored thread (comment 7087442334, finding 1).
- Pinning today's live body as a baseline for a brief that has none (comment 7087292767, finding 5).
narratives.UserStory: As an agent implementing an active brief, I want xbrief:preflight to refuse only when the origin's requirements changed, so that routine comments, labels and closes on the origin issue do not cost a hand stamp or a lifecycle PR.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/vbrief-reconcile/origin-freshness.ts: keep the updated_at check first; on drift resolve the authoritative origin and compare the body baseline, the stored comment thread or the Spec-path source digest (Bound remedy items 1-5), with a shared requirement-shape helper under packages/core/src/intake/.
2. packages/core/src/preflight/evaluate.ts: name the reject reason and print the recovery and usage line with formatFrameworkCommand in the deft form, keeping the #3857 pointer (item 6).
3. Skills pack source content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json and the regenerated sync and refinement SKILL.md files, plus one changelog.d fragment (item 6).
4. Tests: origin-freshness.test.ts, evaluate.test.ts, the intake helper test and a runtime cli-router test assert the pass, warn and refuse cases and the router resolution of the printed commands (item 7); verify with the brief's verify_commands.

A body-route brief (one with an ingest `plan.narratives.Origin` and no Spec-path refused-body record) uses the issue named in that Origin; its body baseline is `plan.narratives.Overview`, or an empty body when ingest wrote no `Overview`. Any other brief has no baseline. `evaluateOriginFreshness` checks the authoritative origin's `updated_at` first; no drift means pass, as today.

Body compare. On drift for a body-route brief, preflight compares `scan(<live body>).transformed_content` (the transform ingest used) with the body baseline, ignoring trailing whitespace. Different: refuse with the reason "origin body changed".

Comment compare (body-route brief, whose stored thread was read from its authoritative issue). On drift, preflight reads the live thread with `fetchIssueComments`. A comment is unread when its id is not in `plan.metadata.issueCommentThread` or its `updated_at` is newer than the stored entry; a brief with no stored thread treats every comment newer than its stamp as unread. An unread comment refuses when it starts with the design-critique comment lead (`model:` then `role:`), when it is the comment `selectIngestCurrentShape` selects, or when it carries an `## Acceptance Criteria` list (`criteriaListUnits`) and its author is the issue author, or `hasWritePermission` says the author may write, or `hasWritePermission` cannot answer. The same three shape tests also run on each stored comment (its scanned body in `issueCommentThread`, author checked the same way): a stored comment that had a requirement shape refuses when the live thread no longer has its id or has it with a newer `updated_at`, whatever its live shape. Every other unread comment goes into one `WARN:` line with count, ids and URLs, never comment text, telling the agent to read them before implementing (#2143). A failed or incomplete thread read refuses.

Spec-path compare. On drift for a Spec-path brief, preflight runs `fetchSpecPathLiveIdentities` on the recorded source and compares the digest with the brief's pin, as `verify:ac` does. Mismatch or unavailable: refuse. A body change on that issue is a `WARN:` line (the lean is the contract). Its thread is read with `fetchIssueComments` without the stored thread (which, for a slice, belongs to the child issue): an unread comment is one with `updated_at` newer than the brief stamp, judged by item 3's live shape tests; a requirement shape or unknown author permission refuses, other comments go into the `WARN:` line, and a failed read refuses. An edit or delete of the recorded lean or criteria record, or a later arc, is caught by the source resolver itself (harvest digest and completed-arc read), since that record, not the rest of the thread, is a Spec-path brief's contract.

Warn-only cases. Every origin other than the authoritative one (including a slice's child issue) prints a `WARN:` line naming it and never refuses, including when its fetch fails. A closed authoritative origin prints a `WARN:` line; closure alone never refuses, and it never stops items 2-4 or a failed fetch of the authoritative origin from refusing. A brief with no baseline keeps today's timestamp refusal.

Recovery text. The reject names its reason (body changed, requirement comment, Spec-path source changed, author permission unknown, no baseline, origin unavailable) and prints the block/unblock pair and the usage line with `formatFrameworkCommand` (`deft scope:block -- <path>`, `deft xbrief:preflight -- <path>`), keeps the #3857 pointer, and keeps "restore `gh` access" for the unavailable cases. The sync and refinement skills (pack source, regenerated) describe this rule instead of a refusal on any newer `updated_at`. CHANGELOG line.

Tests: a plain comment, a label, a close and a same-content body edit pass with the WARN; a changed body, a Constraints-only body change, a changed body on a closed origin, an edited old comment that adds an Acceptance Criteria list, an Acceptance Criteria comment whose author permission read fails, an ingest-time Acceptance Criteria comment edited to plain text, the same comment deleted, a new design-critique record and a changed Spec-path lean refuse; an issue ingested with an empty body passes a plain comment and refuses a new body; a slice is checked against its parent issue, and a slice with a non-empty child thread, an unchanged parent lean and a plain parent comment or label passes with the WARN, while a newer Acceptance Criteria comment by a writer on the parent refuses; a referenced origin's drift or fetch failure warns; a failed thread read refuses; a brief with no baseline refuses on drift; the WARN never contains comment text; the printed recovery strings are exact, and the printed `deft` commands resolve through the CLI router.

For a brief with a baseline (a body-route brief ingested from an issue, or a Spec-path brief with a source record), a comment with no requirement shape, a label, a close and a same-content body edit on the authoritative origin no longer make `xbrief:preflight` refuse; it passes with one `WARN:` line naming the new comments by id and URL, without their text.

A changed body (also on a closed origin), a new or edited comment with a design-critique comment lead, a selected Current shape comment, or an Acceptance Criteria list whose author is the issue author, a writer, or of unknown permission, a comment that had one of those shapes at ingest and is now edited or deleted, and a changed Spec-path source still refuse.

A Spec-path brief is compared through its recorded source issue and lean, the parent issue for a slice; its newer comments are judged by live shape, never against the child's stored thread, so harmless parent activity on a slice with a child thread passes.

A referenced origin other than the authoritative one only warns, including on a fetch failure; a failed or incomplete thread read of the authoritative origin refuses; a brief with no baseline keeps today's timestamp refusal.
The reject names its reason and prints `deft scope:block -- <path>`, `deft scope:unblock -- <path>` and `deft xbrief:preflight -- <path>`, which resolve through the CLI router.
